summary.name: NoteGen
summary.one_liner: NoteGen is an open-source, local-first Markdown note-taking app that captures text, voice, and source material and uses AI to organize it into notes, articles, diagrams, and canvases.
use_cases: Capture quick ideas, voice memos and links before sorting them
Organize meeting fragments and weekly reviews
Research articles and PDFs with AI retrieval
Map loose ideas on an infinite canvas
Draft reports or articles from selected records
Keep local, portable Markdown notes with optional sync
summary.what_it_does: NoteGen puts text, audio, screenshots, images, links, files, and tasks into one capture stream that can be filtered later. An AI agent can search local notes and files, read images and the active document, and run multi-step work with permission, showing its searches and sources. An infinite canvas lets users arrange notes, images, links and shapes, and generate charts, flowcharts and Mermaid diagrams. Notes are standard Markdown files stored locally by default, with an editor supporting tables, math and diagrams. Sync is possible through Git, S3, WebDAV, GitHub, Gitee, GitLab, Gitea or cloud drives, and a self-hosted NoteGen Server is offered.
notable: Local-first: notes stored as plain Markdown files on device by default, readable without the app
Canvas for mapping connected notes, images, links and AI-generated Mermaid diagrams
Agent that searches local knowledge and sources, with self-hosted sync option
caveats: Sponsor-supported project; the page lists sponsors and special thanks but does not state long-term funding terms
Page says no subscription or account is needed and core features are free, but AI features depend on model services the user connects; their costs are not stated on the page
